claims.claim_text: 從 Spammit 的百分比評分、接 Google Perspective API，到 Spamurai 用 ISP、email 網域、TLS 指紋等資料點做行為剖繪……Perspective 那層極易繞過——文字稍微改一下分數就大降。
claims.evidence: 0.12571795 perspective spam: this is almost certainly using the Perspective API; org/email/TLS fingerprinting; going through all 2-letter combinations got us from a 86% spam score down to 1%
claims.note: 系統重建方法與三層結構皆有源文支持。

claims.claim_text: 在 SAO 資料集上壓縮比達 2.06×，勝過 zstd 的 1.31× 與 xz 的 1.64×，壓縮速度 203 MB/s 還比 zstd 快。
claims.evidence: SAO: OpenZL x2.06; zstd -3 x1.31; xz -9 x1.64; OpenZL 203 MB/s vs zstd 115 MB/s; SDDL; Meta

claims.claim_text: 256 路鎖分片在所有讀寫比例下幾乎都最快，8 核時對單鎖有近 8 倍吞吐，程式碼卻只多約 15 行……單鎖會負成長，RWMutex 的寫入甚至比普通 mutex 還慢。
claims.evidence: A 256-way striped map (sharded) was the all-around winner — up to 8× faster than a single sync.Mutex at 8 cores — and it's about 15 lines of code; Negative scaling is real; sync.RWMutex worse than a plain mutex for writes

claims.claim_text: OpenAI 預覽新旗艦 GPT-5.6，並一次推出 Sol、Terra、Luna 三個分級……目前只開放給部分合作夥伴，更廣的可用時程尚未公布。
claims.note: primary source https://openai.com/index/previewing-gpt-5-6-sol/ 對 WebFetch 回傳 HTTP 403，無法二次抓取，依規定不以自身知識核實。此則為對『預覽公告』的轉述，文內已充分 hedge（預覽／僅部分合作夥伴／時程尚未公布），不是其他內容所依賴的載重技術主張，故降為 medium load。次級科技媒體（gslin link blog）對三分級報導一致。人工 review 時請對照官方頁面確認分級命名。

claims.claim_text: pg_plan_advice 不是硬塞計畫，而是遮掉某些選項、逼 planner 從剩下的合法計畫裡挑……官方提醒：資料分布一變，鎖死的計畫可能反而拖累效能。
claims.evidence: it operates by constraining the planner's choices, not by replacing it ... you will only ever get a plan that the core planner would have considered; if the distribution of the underlying data changes ... a very poor plan may be chosen; covers join order, join method, scan method, parallelism

claims.claim_text: 用強化學習（類似 AlphaGo Zero 自我對弈）找架構與拓樸，再用 CNN 當電磁模擬代理模型，把 scattering parameter 預測從數小時壓到毫秒……做出 30 到 100 GHz 毫米波功率放大器，宣稱效率創紀錄。AI 會幻想出不能用的設計。
claims.evidence: the approach echoes AI systems such as AlphaGo Zero; reduced to milliseconds; a power amplifier spanning 30 to 100 GHz ... best combination of wide bandwidth, output power, and efficiency then reported for a silicon-based power amplifier; AI can hallucinate a design ... human oversight

claims.claim_text: 老合成器只有 2 MHz CPU、256 byte RAM，又沒有硬體流量控制……解法是把 SysEx 切成 256 byte 區塊、每塊間隔約 60ms。
claims.evidence: an 8-bit Hitachi 6305 running at a clock speed of 2 MHz, with a tiny 256-byte RAM buffer; standard MIDI lacks hardware handshaking lines (no RTS/CTS pins); const CHUNK_SIZE = 256; const INTER_CHUNK_DELAY = 60

claims.claim_text: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide 是給瀏覽器與輔助技術開發者看的規格示範，不是給網頁工程師抄的最佳實踐……別把 LLM 指向 APG 生程式碼，因為研究顯示 ARIA 用得越多、無障礙錯誤反而越多。
claims.evidence: Browser and assistive technology developers can thus utilize code in this guide; its code examples near-exclusively ... favor ARIA; Increased ARIA usage on pages was associated with higher detected errors

claims.claim_text: Welterweight Go 把 Go 的結構子型、泛型，與不一致的執行期表示一次形式化……給了 WG 與 LWG 兩套演算……不靠 monomorphization，而用執行期型別轉換與 adaptor method……守住分離編譯。
claims.evidence: We introduce WG (Welterweight Go) ... We also develop LWG; raw struct values and interface values that carry runtime type information (RTTI); Unlike existing approaches based on static monomorphisation, our compilation strategy uses runtime type conversions and adaptor methods; compatibility with separate compilation

claims.claim_text: devenv 把每次 shell 啟動的 70ms 砍到 16ms……光 devenv 自己就有約 486 次找不到函式庫的失敗開檔、ImageMagick 更達 1225 次。解法是復活 per-DSO 的 ELF note 快取：patchelf 0.19 加旗標寫入相依位置，改過的 glibc loader 直接讀。
claims.evidence: drops devenv version and hook-should-activate from about 70ms to about 16ms; ~486 failing .so opens; ImageMagick ~1225; patchelf --build-resolution-cache ... shipped in patchelf 0.19.0; patched glibc loader reads per-DSO resolution notes
